avoid: Heavy metal coins (use plastic or bells for safety)
children.game_version: The 'Follow the Sound' game: one child leads the rhythm with their 'coins' (bells) and others must match it exactly in silence.

avoid: Long periods of standing without support
seniors.seated_version: Perform the belt-hold while seated in a semi-circle, using rhythmic torso sways and heel taps to create the coin sound.
seniors.standing_version: Reduce the travel of the steps, focusing on the rhythmic weight shift while holding a stable support or neighboring belts.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slow the 2/4 pulse; limit torso rotation to protect the spine.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Holding belts with the left arm over the right arm
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Steady, providing the impulse to shake the chest coins
movement_profile.partnering: Connected via belt-hold in a chain

signature_moves.description: Dancers link by gripping the belts of those beside them, left arm over right.
signature_moves.name: Belt-hold chain

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Breaking the silence with vocalization or losing the rhythmic pulse of the coins.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Steady percussive strikes on the beat
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is characterized by the absence of melody or drums, replaced by the sharp, metallic clinking of silver coins striking each other in a 2/4 meter.

basic_steps: Form a half-circle with other dancers
Reach for the belts of neighbors, crossing left arm over the right
Listen for the collective rhythm of the chest coins
Step in a 2/4 meter, ensuring the coins strike on the beat
teaching.level_notes: Requires high rhythmic synchronization as there is no external music to follow.
